next, intimate, RV.
last, youngest, RV. vi, 21, 5, (ifc. with numerals) less by, RPrāt.
अवम (अम्), n. (scil. दिन) or (आनि) pl. the difference (expressed in days of twenty-four hours) existing between the lunar months and the corresponding solar ones, VarBṛS. &c.
a: अवम — a. [अव-अमच् Uṇ. 5. 54.] 1 Sinful, wicked. --2 Contemptible, mean, undermost, lowest. --3 Base, low, inferior (opp. परम); अनलकानलकानवमां पुरीं R. 9. 14; see अनवम; या त उक्तिरवमा या परमा Rv. 6. 25. 1. --4 Next, intimate. --5 Last, youngest. --6 decreasing. --मः 1 A protector. --2 A class of Manes; त्रिविधाः पितरः अवमा ऊर्वाः काव्याश्च. --मं 1 Sin. --2 A lunar day exactly coinciding with a solar one; the difference between a Cāndra (29 days, 31 Ghaṭikās and 50 Palas) and a solar month (30 days); तिथ्यंतद्वंयमेको दिनवारः स्पृशति यत्र तद्भवत्यवमदिनं Jyotiṣa.
अवमंथ — a. [अवमथ्नाति अव-मंथ्-अच्] Producing swellings. --थः A kind of disease, swellings caused by boils or contusions.
अवमंतव्य, अवमान्य — pot. p. 1 To be treated with disrespect, or slighted; बालोऽपि नावमंतव्यो मनुष्य इति भूमिपः Ms. 7. 8, 9. 82. --2 Contemptible, mean.
अवमंतृ — a. 1 Disrespectful, contemptuous, despising. --2 Arrogant.

Subj. 2. sg. मंस्थाः, 2.pl. -मध्वम्, Bhaṭṭ.; ep. also P. -मन्यति fut. -मंस्यति, MBh. iv, 444) to despise, treat contemptuously, MBh. &c.; to repudiate, refuse, ib. : Pass. -मन्यते to be treated contemptuously: Caus. (Pot. -मानयेत्) to despise, treat contemptuously, Mn. ii, 50.
a: अवमन् — {c4c} A. (or Poet. P.) 1 To despise, contemn, disregard, disrespect; चतुर्दिगीशानवमत्य मानिनी Ku. 5. 53; Ms. 2. 11, 4. 135, 7. 150; V. 2. 11. --2 To undervalue, depreciate, slight, make light of; तदीशितारं चेदीनां भवांस्तमवमंस्त मा Śi. 2. 95; जगन्मंगलमात्मानं कथं त्वमवमन्यसे U. 7. 8; Bk. 8. 81; 12. 25; 15. 14, 66. --Caus. To despise &c.; या चैनं नावमानयेत् Ms. 2. 50, 4. 136.

a: अवमृद् — {c9c} P. 1 To grind or pound down, to reduce by friction; crush, tread down, trample upon; अवमृद्रन्स राष्ट्राणि पार्थिवानां हयोत्तमः Mb. --2 To rub. --Caus. To pound down &c.

m: अव-√ मृज् -मार्ष्टि (ind.p. मृज्य) to wipe or rub off Comm. on TBr.; to wipe or rub, clean by wiping, ŚBr. &c.: Pass. (Pot. -मृज्येत with the sense of Ā.) to rub one's (limbs, गात्राणि), MBh. xiii, 5006.
a: अवमृज् — {c2c} P. 1 To rub off, to strip off, remove; लेपमवमार्ष्टि. --2 To efface.

m: अव-√ मिह् -मेहति, to urine towards or upon (acc.), ŚBr.; MārkP.; to urine, BhP.; to pour out (as Soma), RV. ix, 74, 4.

v: na॰ ava + muca--BAve lyuw । banDanarAhitye unmocane ।
m: अव-मोचन n. loosening
setting at liberty, L.
‘where horses are unharnessed’, stage, a place for resting or settling, BhP.
(also) putting on (?), Nalac.
a: अवमोचनं — Setting at liberty, loosening, letting go.

m: अव-मोहन n. a narcotic, Car.

अव-√ मुच् P. (p. -मुञ्चत्) to loosen, AV. viii, 2, 2; to let go, VarBṛS.; (ind.p. -मुच्य) to unharness, MBh. iii, 2870; (generally ind.p. -मुच्य) to take off (as a garment &c.), MBh. &c.: Ā. (p. -मुञ्चमन) to liberate one's self from, strip off, AV. viii, 1, 4.
a: अवमुच् — {c6c} P. 1 To let loose, loosen (as a horse). --2 To take off (a garment &c.); मेखलां, किरीटं, वासांसि, भूषणानि &c. --3 To unharness.

m: अव-√ मुष् to take away, Kāṭh.
